bio.text: Matthew Dunlap is the Democratic nominee for Maine's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.

He is Maine's State Auditor, an office he has held since November 2022, and earlier served as Maine Secretary of State (2005 to 2011 and 2013 to 2021) and in the Maine House of Representatives (1996 to 2004).
He earned a bachelor's degree in history and a master's degree in English literature from the University of Maine.
Outside politics he worked for about 25 years as a journalist and columnist for outlets including The Northwoods Sporting Journal.
